editorial.last_message: Claims all five commands and 87 catalog types implemented; 18 passing test groups are corroborated. Current grading is 248/249 after hidden-fixture and integration-weighting repairs. One zero-count Hollerith reader defect remains; external CAD validation is unverified.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with substantial general JavaScript codecs and native geometry algorithms; retained independent review found no canned answers or hidden-test access. Eighteen self-test groups, 87 schema types, a 54-entity shared-edge cube and byte-identical CLI normalization are corroborated. The malformed-number self-test correction preserves valid physical widths. Legal trailing comments preserve generic type/default distinctions, which external consumers may discard; external CAD validation remains unverified. Original 259/261 became 260/261 after the invalid Face writer fixture was repaired in 1.0.18. Official 1.0.19 grading is 248/249: all 246 unchanged outcomes match the prior publication and all three appendix integrations pass. The remaining failure accepts illegal 0H. The independently reviewed normalization and consolidation retain all former assertions while explicitly changing the denominator from 261 to 249; this is revised scoring, not improved source. Root verified committed rubric, pinned grader, preserved original source/result, unchanged model input, complete session accounting and the prior publication chain. Tokens, reasoning, tool calls and generation cost are unchanged. No new generation calls were made.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.

IGES 1.0.20 retained-source regrade: all 249 case IDs and245 untouched outcomes preserved; four supporting View fixtures corrected to the complete defaulted canonical shape. Score unchanged. All original generation/source/session/accounting artifacts and complete previous publication remain preserved. No additional model calls or cost.

IGES 1.0.21 saved-source regrade normalizes only the hidden ex1 Type406 Form5 Real-zero spelling. All 249 IDs and 248 untouched outcomes remain identical; this submission score is unchanged. Full prior publication, raw source/session/usage and generation metadata remain preserved. No extra model calls or inference cost.
